payload.instruction: Turn the image into a drawing made from chalk
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Compared with the source image, has the edited image as a whole been transformed into a drawing made from chalk, including the important subjects as well as the background, rather than merely given chalk-like texture or contours?
node.criteria: complete: the overall image reads as a chalk drawing, with the main subjects and scene rendered in drawing-like marks and chalk texture rather than retaining substantial photographic detail. partial: clear progress toward a chalk drawing, such as chalk-like texture, softened contours, or stylized background, but substantial photographic detail remains in important subjects or areas, or the image otherwise still reads partly as a photograph. absent: no visible progress toward a chalk drawing. unknown: source/edit evidence is insufficient to judge. Assess the whole image against the source; graininess or sketchy outlines alone do not establish completion. Describe any substantial photographic detail or other visible incompleteness when present. Unrelated edits do not count as progress.
node.binding: Compare the source image with the edited image. Target: the whole image, including important subjects and background. Reference: a drawing made from chalk.

outcome.description: Transform the image into a chalk drawing.

response.content: {"status":"partial","evidence":"The edited image has a chalky, smudged background and softened, sketch-like contours, but the giraffes retain substantial photographic detail in their patterned bodies and legs, so the whole scene does not fully read as a chalk drawing.","confidence":0.96}
